data.title: 史黛菈 · 盛夏礁石的炽红比基尼傲立
data.description: 烈日当空的热带海滩，巨型黑色礁石经受着白浪拍打。史黛菈身穿一袭极具视觉冲击力的炽红挂脖比基尼，傲然立于礁石之上。阳光晒得她雪白娇嫩的肌肤泛着健康的红晕，细细的水珠在锁骨与丰满胸口泛着微光。红发随海风肆意飞扬，皇女单手叉腰侧身而立，眼波流转中尽显傲娇皇女的绝对自信与惹火诱惑。
data.action: posing confidently on black seaside rocks against crashing waves, crimson halter bikini, red twintails fluttering, water droplets glistening on bare skin, proud blushing smirk
data.location: rugged ocean rocks with white foaming waves under bright summer sun
data.lighting: dazzling summer sunlight creating high-contrast specular reflections on wet skin
data.mood: fierce passionate beauty, sun-drenched fiery radiance
data.promptProse: Standing proudly on ocean rocks with crashing turquoise waves behind her, Stella Vermillion poses in a fiery red halter bikini. Sunlight glistens on her bare shoulders and long red twintails as she smirks with proud, tsundere affection.
data.animaCaption: Stella posing on ocean rocks in a fiery red bikini against crashing turquoise waves.
